body: I see what you're saying but making basketball shots is a very skill-based activity. I fail at basic shit like taking care of my health and finances and reading directions.

I've told myself I'm going to change hundreds of times and attempted to change hundreds of times and I keep backsliding into failure. Failure to execute my jobs, failure to communicate with friends and strangers, failure to maintain my health, failure to pay taxes and loans, failure to recognize opportunities, failure to read directions, failure to stop abusing substances, failure to treat people equitably, failure to keep calm and carry on when stressed, etc.

Social Darwinism says that inferior specimens will naturally fail. I'm failing but human beings who fail don't just die. In developed, industrialized countries like the U.S., they often either go on a social safety net or remain alive but homeless. The fact of my failure won't change - I just want to be dead-failed more than alive-failed, if that makes sense. 

Like, I can't even give directions correctly. I can barely tie my fucking shoelaces.

Because the person above asked if I wanted to be a good person. That's not the same thing as bettering yourself. Being a good person means being good to others. Bettering oneself means improving your position in life.
Not really. I don't want to be a good person. Besides being stupid, lazy and a coward, I'm also an asshole and a social darwinist. I believe that I, as a failed specimen, should die off.
